## Teaching points

1. Hoarseness, cough and coryza favor a viral cause. An uncomplicated low-risk sore throat needs supportive care.
2. Cough, coryza and hoarseness make a viral syndrome more likely; check for airway or deep-neck warning signs.
3. For this mild presentation, symptom care and expectations matter more than investigations.
4. Explain what changes would require reassessment rather than giving an unsupported antibiotic prescription.
